## Workspace dependencies

[`fw-agent`](/crates/fw-agent/), [`fw-config`](/crates/fw-config/), [`fw-http`](/crates/fw-http/), [`fw-model`](/crates/fw-model/), [`fw-proc`](/crates/fw-proc/), [`fw-rag-core`](/crates/fw-rag-core/), [`fw-toolcall`](/crates/fw-toolcall/). It also uses 32 crates from outside the workspace.

## Features

`codegraph`, `default`, `embed-native`, `embed-ort`, `fsindex`, `full`, `localstore`, `memory`, `ocr`, `ocr-sqlite`, `postgres`, `rag`, `sql`, `sqlite`, `vec`

## Build

Run this from the repository root.

```bash
cargo build --release -p fw-rag
```
